scenarios.description: One prompt, one assistant completion with known usage.
Assistant tool call, successful tool execution, second assistant completion.
The tool throws; the model recovers with a final answer.
The provider rejects the request with a non-retryable error.
RPC abort while the assistant response is streaming.
RPC abort while a tool is executing.
The assistant stops on the output-length limit.

terminals.note: output-length stop: the run ended without the model finishing

scenarios.description: The provider reports reasoning tokens and reasoning content.
Three prompts with known usage, then the process exits and a new process reopens the session file.
Two prompts, then a manual compaction whose summary also reports usage.
Two prompts, then a fork from the second user message, then one more prompt on the fork.
A crafted durable session holding one child_usage_attributed entry, reopened by a real Prime process (no live RLM child).
